description: Decide an action for each open support ticket using the first rule that applies: an `urgent` ticket with no assignee gets `page`; an `urgent` ticket, or a `high` ticket older than 7 days, gets `escalate`; a ticket older than 30 days gets `close-stale`; any other ticket gets no action. Return a list of records with `id` and `action` for the tickets that get an action, in the order the tickets are listed.

types.Ticket: Record {id: String, priority: String, age: Int, assignee: Option<String>}

capabilities.description: Lists open tickets with priority (low, high, or urgent), age in whole days, and assignee if any.
